en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a large complex of rectangular, multi‑storey barracks-style buildings with inner courtyards, laid out in a grid in an urban setting surrounded by smaller houses. Trees line some paths and streets. The lower margin contains printed captions in red identifying the scene, while the rest of the card is filled with handwritten cursive text.
